text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yawn... S-stop that, Yukino. C'mon, wakey-wakey, eggs and bakey...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer? Y-you weren't s'posed t'hear
that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I couldn't really get t'sleep last
night...
But I should be right as rain after
some coffee!
Just a typical city morning!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Black coffee sure is bitter... But it
ought t'wake
me right up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Yukino Bijin didn't get
much sleep
last night.
